evidence: Adds functional test coverage specifically for P2P outbound connection management, stale-tip outbounds, and peer network diversification.
rationale: Adds automated functional test coverage for autonomous outbound connection logic that previously lacked end-to-end testing, including stale-tip extra connections (#11560) and network-diversified peer management (#27213). While valuable for verifying partition and eclipse resistance mechanisms, it introduces tests rather than fixing active vulnerabilities.
